title: Radiators and Blue Hour
author: Ada Eastwick
blurb: Zephyrine Yarrow, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
